item.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon_hear: It still beats with the six elements of the world.
Absorb: awakens every element, +16 health, +240 mana and +15% spell power (once).
Hold the use button for 3 s to absorb.
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_heart.al: You already carry the dragon's heart within you.
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_heart.us: The six elements roar in your veins. You absorbed the Heart of the Primordial Dragon!
announce.isekai_mahou.primordial_heart.a: %s absorbed the Heart of the Primordial Dragon!
banner.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.sl: ✦ Dragon Slayer ✦ — the Primordial Dragon has fallen
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.rift: Something far greater awoke with the Herald's fall...
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.phas: Light and Shadow: the End of Elements
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.doma: Nothing escapes the beginning and end of all things
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.anni: Only a COUNTERSPELL stops it: nobody dies... but nobody walks away whole
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.fina: The elements are free once more
The sky tears open above the arena!
Little ones... you struck down my Herald. Now face the origin of all magic!
The fire dies... and the sea freezes!
Feel the weight of the earth itself!
Let the storm sweep you from the sky!
Light and darkness... I am the beginning and the end!
So... the elements have chosen you...
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.h: Built for 6 max-level heroes. It changes element every 20% — use the OPPOSITE and SAVE YOUR COUNTERSPELL for the Ultimates!
Hiding won't help: seeker orbs are coming for you!
Breath! Leave the cone marked on the ground.
Meteors chase you — run and leave the circle once it locks!
Sea of Lava! Stay on the UNMARKED slices.
Tsunami! Leave the lane before the wave passes.
Ice Prison: leave the blue circle before it locks!
Earthquake: JUMP over each shockwave ring!
It will crash into the circle — and be stuck on the ground afterwards!
Tornadoes! Keep away: they pull you in and toss you up.
The rain SOAKED you: lightning arcs between wet targets. Spread out!
Gales sweep across the arena: leave the lanes!
Closed Domain! The barrier won't break from inside — survive what comes.
The dragon's domain has fallen!
Shadow Clones: while they live, the dragon takes half damage. Bring them down!
Your Simple Domain withstood the Annihilation!
The elemental currents drag you back into the arena!
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.e: The Primordial Dragon is EXHAUSTED on the ground — attack now!
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.t: This block is the dragon's magic: it will return to normal by itself.
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.v: The Primordial Dragon has been defeated! The six elements are at peace.
command.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.f: Could not summon the Primordial Dragon.
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.ston: Counter it — or become statues in the dragon's garden
boss.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.obli: Counter it — or forget everything you know
Chains of the Abyss... stay where you are!
Look at me... and turn to stone!
Your life, your magic... everything returns to the origin!
Forget the words you have learned!
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.h: Chains of the Abyss: leave the circle before it locks! Chained? BREAK the anchor within 15 s or it turns you to stone.
You have been CHAINED! Break the anchor (hits, arrows, spells) before it crushes you.
Mark of Sacrifice on %s! At least %s players INSIDE the circle to split the blow!
The sacrifice was shared! Nobody turned to stone.
Nobody shared the blow: the marked one became a statue and gained Ruin!
Gorgon Gaze! TURN YOUR BACK to the dragon (or hide) before the flash!
You looked away in time — you only stiffened.
Inversion of Fate: the marked will SWAP places! Watch where your partner stands.
Fate threw you into someone else's place!
Primordial Siphon! Hide behind pillars or deal damage to BREAK the siphon!
Seal of Oblivion: leave the purple circle or your active loadout vanishes for 20 s!
Curse of Forgetting: leave the circle or your spells will VANISH from memory!
ULTIMATE! Only a COUNTERSPELL (power 2, on the Stack) stops it — counter it NOW!
Everyone turned to stone! Whoever is free: CROUCH next to an ally for 2 s to break the statue.
The Tide of Oblivion erased your loadouts! Switch loadouts (Alt + wheel) and lift the curse by crouching next to an ally.
The Annihilation left everyone hanging by a thread... and branded them with Ruin.
Your Simple Domain held back half of the stone!
message.isekai_mahou.primordial_dragon.c: The anchor shattered: you are free!
You are a STATUE (%s s): the stone drains health and mana. An ally crouching next to you for 2 s breaks it!
☠ You turned to stone. Ask an ally to CROUCH next to you for 2 seconds.
The stone crumbles. You can move again.
An ally cracked the stone: you are free!
CURSE OF FORGETTING (%s s): your spells may vanish from memory!
The words slip from your mind... the spell is lost!
You remember all of your spells again.
✖ Loadout %s was ERASED from your memory for %s s! Switch loadouts (Alt + wheel).
RUIN: −%s%% max health until the fight ends!
The Ruin faded: your max health is back.
